meta.title: Point at the page and attach screenshots: proposed

frontend.label: UI step where the work started

nodes.label: Select Elements or Alt
nodes.explanation: Select Elements leads a row of page-context tools at the top of docked chat, beside Arrow, Line, Box, Undo and Redo, so the tools follow the dock's corner instead of covering the app's header at the top centre (SURF-7, SURF-5, MENU-1). The toggle latches selection on, and Enter on it latches it from the keyboard (KEY-12). Holding Alt alone (Option on macOS) starts it from the page or the composer on the first pointer move, or after 300 ms (KEY-2, O34); any other key pressed first cancels it, so Alt+Ctrl+R, Alt+Shift+D, a page's own Alt shortcut and a character typed with Option never start it (keyboard-and-screen-reader-07). The selection records what started it: one Alt started ends when Alt is released or the window loses focus; one the toggle latched stays on through an Alt press, an Option character, Alt+Ctrl+R and a window switch, until Escape, its toggle, another tool, closing chat or a send that takes a screenshot (KEY-12, KEY-8; page-context-11). Annotations off removes the tools and Alt-hold (SEL-11). Picks reach the page wherever devhost draws nothing; the empty strip above the toolbar is toolbar-shell's (SURF-11; page-context-03, related).

sources.label: Replaces: tools fixed at the page's top centre
Replaces: Alt keys checked by key name only
Replaces: window blur ends any selection

nodes.label: Pick an element
nodes.explanation: One resolver serves Select Elements, Alt-hold and Alt + right-click: it outlines the element under the pointer with its role and name before the click, and a click adds a mark with the draft's next number, '#3', drawn on the element, plus its row; each pick is announced once, 'Mark 3 added: button Add to cart' (SEL-9, FB-9). From the keyboard, with Select Elements latched, the highlight starts on the element focused before, else the main landmark; the arrows walk to the parent, the first child and the siblings, Enter picks and Shift+F10 opens the source menu, each move announced while focus stays on the toggle (KEY-12, KEY-1; page-context-10). Escape leaves the mode and does nothing else, in the composer too: it never stops the turn, which Stop Turn and Alt+Ctrl+. do (KEY-8, KEY-9; keyboard-and-screen-reader-06). The hint comes from the bindings' one definition, 'Select Elements · click an element to add it', then the Esc key cap and 'Finish' (KEY-13, WORD-3; page-context-08). A pointer pick returns focus to the composer and a keyboard-latched mode keeps it on the toggle, a reading of KEY-6 and KEY-12 recorded for the reference's author.

sources.label: Replaces: click adds marker #(count + 1)
Replaces: Escape listener racing the composer's
Replaces: 'Annotate', words beside the Esc cap

nodes.label: Draw Arrow, Line or Box
nodes.explanation: A drawing tool stays armed until Escape or another tool, so three boxes take three drags; its hint reads 'Box · drag, or click two corners', then Esc 'Finish' (KEY-13; page-context-04, page-context-08). Two clicks set the start and the end as a drag does, with a preview between them; from the keyboard, Enter on a highlighted element sets each end, and Box boxes it on one Enter (KEY-12; page-context-10). Each drawing takes the next number from the marks' counter and shows it on the page, '#4', its row reading '#4 Box around button Add to cart' (SEL-9; page-context-04). Every mark and drawing is anchored to its element as an offset and re-measured on scroll, resize, layout change and DOM mutation, a hot update's re-render included, within one frame; when its element leaves the page, so does the mark, and its row reads '#4 is no longer on this page' with Select Again and Remove, never framing another element (SURF-12; page-context-02). Marks paint beneath the bar, the notice stack and docked chat (SURF-1). Moving a drawing by its stroke is an action Undo reverses.

sources.label: Replaces: points in fixed document coordinates
Replaces: shapes drawn only by press and drag
Replaces: 'Drag To Draw A arrow' hint

nodes.label: Share this tab
nodes.explanation: Share Tab, beside Send, opens the browser's picker; only a browser tab is accepted, and a window or a whole screen ends with 'Pick this browser tab: a window or a whole screen cannot show the page's marks.' (FAIL-2). Closing the picker or choosing its Cancel leaves nothing: no line, no alert, and Share Tab is ready again (FAIL-5, WORD-7; page-context-09). A capture the system refuses says where to allow it, 'Your browser may not record the screen. Allow it in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Screen Recording, then choose Share Tab again.', with the browser's own text behind Copy Error, kept until Dismiss or a share that succeeds (FAIL-2, FB-6; page-context-09). The share's outcomes read verb first: 'Shared this tab · each message takes a screenshot while the camera is on', and 'Stopped sharing this tab · from the browser's sharing control', never a failure (WORD-4, FAIL-5, FB-4); with chat closed they enter the one notice stack (FB-8). While the camera is on, each Send takes one screenshot; devhost never sends video.

sources.label: Reuses: Share Tab, camera toggle, Stop Sharing
Reuses: picker that accepts only a browser tab
Replaces: raw browser text for every refusal

nodes.label: Undo the last change
nodes.explanation: One undo history per draft records every page-context action: add, move or remove a mark, draw, move or remove a drawing, and Clear Page Context. Undo reverses the last one, whatever it was, back to the start of the draft, and Redo reapplies it; undoing a removal brings the item back with its number. Each names what it will reverse in its tooltip and accessible description, 'Undo Move #4 Box', its key hint ⌘Z or Ctrl+Z drawn from the binding's one definition (UNDO-7, KEY-13, BAR-4). Mod+Z and Mod+Shift+Z act while Select Elements or a drawing tool is active, or while focus is in devhost outside a text field; in the app's own fields and in the composer they stay those fields' undo (KEY-12). Send ends the draft's history. It replaces Undo Drawing, which removed the newest shape whatever the last action was, never reversed a move, and left Clear Page Context with no way back (page-context-04). This undo writes nothing.

sources.label: Replaces: Undo Drawing drops the newest shape
Replaces: Clear Page Context with no undo

nodes.label: Review page context
nodes.explanation: Under the composer, page context lists every item in number order, one row each, saying what it sends: '#2 button Add to cart · ProductCard.tsx:42', or '· no source found' until component-source resolves React 19 (page-context-06, related); '#4 Box around button Add to cart'; once per message 'Page · /checkout?step=2 · web · fix-nav', its URL, service and checkout label (SEL-3, SEL-4, WORD-8); with a tab shared, 'Screenshot of this tab, taken when you send'. Each row expands to the exact fields that leave the machine, and hovering a row outlines its item on the page (SEL-9, REV-6; page-context-07, page-context-04). Removing a mark leaves every other number as it is; the next pick takes the next unused number (SEL-9; page-context-01). A '#3' in the message that no pick carries is flagged before Send, '#3 is not in page context', with Select Again; Send asks only when the message cites a mark that is gone: 'Your message mentions #3, which is no longer on this page.', Select Again focused, Send Anyway beside it (REV-6, REV-4; journey-agent-fix-04). Empty: 'No elements picked' (STATE-2). One store feeds the rows and the send (SEL-1).

sources.label: Replaces: rows '#n label' and 'n. kind' only
Replaces: removal renumbers the other marks

nodes.label: Crop the screenshot
nodes.explanation: With the tab shared and the camera on, Send takes one screenshot: devhost hides its toolbar, chat and tooltips, keeps the marks and drawings, and waits up to 10 s for a frame that shows them gone, else fails the send with the draft kept. The busy Send keeps focus and says each step: 'Taking screenshot…', 'Crop the screenshot to continue', 'Sending…' (FB-1, KEY-11, STATE-1); meanwhile the tools, rows and Undo are unavailable with 'Sending: page context changes wait until the message is sent' (MENU-3, HOLD-1). The crop preview opens over the page with the frame: drag an area, or set Left, Top, Width and Height, where Enter applies a value and never shares and no key reaches the page (KEY-9, KEY-5). Share Selected Area or Share Whole Tab continues; Escape or Cancel cancels the send with 'Not sent · your draft and page context stay' (KEY-8, FAIL-5). It stays a modal dialog, a proposed exception to SURF-3, and focus returns to Send when it closes (KEY-6). The rows above already showed what goes with the image (page-context-07).

sources.label: Reuses: hide devhost surfaces, wait for a frame
Reuses: crop preview, fields and buttons

nodes.label: send with page context
nodes.explanation: Send writes once on the chat socket, to the conversation the composer shows, also right after New Conversation (SEL-8). The composer names the agent and the edit mode; with page context it starts at This checkout (live), 'This checkout (live) · fix-nav', a control agent-chat owns (O1, REV-6). send carries pageContext as a structured field beside its mode, never JSON appended to the text; the server renders it into the agent's input as a labelled 'Page context' section and journals it as a page-context record (UNDO-8, CC-40; the field is a [discuss] item for the reference's author). The agent receives once the page's title, URL, service, checkout label, viewport, scroll offsets and pixel ratio, and the screenshot's size, crop and scale; per mark its element path, role and name, nearby text, bounds, styles once and its source or that none was found; per drawing its anchor, never an ID (SEL-3, SURF-12; page-context-07, page-context-02). The 8 MiB limit and PNG or JPEG images stay. When chat cannot take a message or the connection is lost, Send says why and picks stay (HOLD-5, HOLD-2).

sources.label: Replaces: JSON appended to the message text
Reuses: send command with text and images
Reuses: mode instructions, 8 MiB limit

nodes.label: Sent with page context
nodes.explanation: The message appears at once as the person's with 'Not sent yet' until the acknowledgement, then its mode line, 'Mode: This checkout (live) · fix-nav' (WORD-10, UNDO-8). Under it, 'Page context: 2 marks, 1 drawing, 1 screenshot' expands to the same rows as before Send, each with the fields it carried, and Show Raw shows the exact data the agent received; the person's text shows without JSON (UNDO-8, FB-2; page-context-07). The record comes from the session's journal, so every page and a reload show it (CC-40). Sending clears only the items that went out, and their undo history ends with them (UNDO-7). No notice reports a send: the message is the receipt, and agent-chat's delivery states apply; a lost acknowledgement reads Delivery unconfirmed and is never resent (FB-5, REV-12). There is no Undo for a sent message: this flow's undo is the page-context history before Send (UNDO-7) and the draft kept through reloads (UNDO-2).

sources.label: Replaces: collapsed raw JSON in a 240 px box
Reuses: sent marks and drawings cleared

nodes.label: Reload restores marks
nodes.explanation: A reload devhost or the person causes (the browser's own, Reload Now, a worktree switch, Restart Stack on a recovery page, an agent edit that reloads) brings back the unsent text from browser storage, as today, and the images and page context from the control server's draft record for this stack, page origin and conversation: each pick's element path and offsets, each drawing's shape and anchor, never a screenshot (UNDO-2, CC-19). Marks whose elements still resolve return with their numbers; the rest stay listed, '#3 is no longer on this page', with Select Again and Remove, and the page says once 'Restored 2 of 3 marks after the reload · #3 is no longer on this page' (UNDO-2, SEL-9, FB-4, WORD-4; journey-agent-fix-04, page-context-05). A tab share ends with the page, 'Stopped sharing this tab · the page reloaded'. A switch's reach line names page context before it runs, '3 marks · they come back where their elements still exist; the tab share ends' (SEL-5, REV-3). Until the draft record ships, the #n flag already warns before Send.

sources.label: Replaces: marks and shapes in memory only
Reuses: unsent text kept across reloads

nodes.label: Not sent; draft kept
nodes.explanation: A cancelled crop, a capture that cannot confirm devhost's surfaces are hidden, or a send the server refuses (over 8 MiB, an image that is not PNG or JPEG) sends nothing and keeps the draft, the marks and the drawings, as today and as the docs promise. The reason shows where Send is, in words, with the original text behind Copy Error (FAIL-2, UNDO-4); a cancel reads neutrally, 'Not sent · your draft and page context stay', never as a failure (FAIL-5, WORD-7). A lost connection makes Send unavailable with its reason while picking, drawing, the rows and Undo stay, because none of them writes (HOLD-2). Nothing is replayed: the person sends again when ready.

sources.label: Reuses: a cancel keeps the draft and context
Reuses: a failed send clears nothing

cards.title: What changes versus today
items: Removed: renumbering when a mark is removed; the drawings' separate numbering by list position; the tool switching itself off after one shape; Undo Drawing, which removed the newest shape and never a move; Escape in the composer stopping the agent's turn; Alt chords and Option characters starting Select Elements, and an Alt release or a window switch ending a selection the toggle latched; 'Annotate' and the words beside the Esc key cap; the raw rejection after a closed picker; the floating tools at the top centre of the page; page context appended to the text as JSON; drawing IDs and the second styles format in what the agent receives; a reload silently dropping every mark and drawing
Merged: marks and drawings share one counter and one list; Select Elements, Alt-hold and Alt + right-click share one resolver; the review before Send and the sent record show the same rows

New: keyboard picking and drawing, and drawing with two clicks; anchored marks that say when their element is gone; rows that say what each item sends, with the page's service, checkout and 'no source found'; the #n flag and the gone-mark question with Select Again; Undo and Redo of any page-context action with Mod+Z; progress on the busy Send; the share's neutral outcomes and a worded system denial; the draft record that restores page context after a reload; viewport, scroll and scale in what the agent receives; Show Raw on the sent record

Changed: Escape leaves a page-context mode and never stops a turn (KEY-8, CC-29, CC-31); Alt alone starts selection after a pointer move or 300 ms, and only a selection Alt started ends on its release or a window switch (KEY-2, KEY-12, O34); a drawing tool stays armed; the tools move into docked chat (SURF-7); marks survive a reload while their elements exist (CC-19); page context is sent as a structured field and journaled as a record (CC-40); the hint words (KEY-13, WORD-3)

Kept: three ways in, Alt working in the composer but never in the page's own fields; picks and drawings over the page's own popovers and modal dialogs; Escape leaving a mode from anywhere; a selection Alt started ending on its release; only a browser tab accepted; devhost hidden in the screenshot or the send fails with the draft kept; the crop preview with its fields, Cancel and Escape keeping the draft; one image per message, never video; the draft stored before page context is prepared; sending clears only what was sent; the server's mode instructions, 8 MiB and PNG or JPEG limits; the sent data kept with the message; Delivery unconfirmed, never resent

cards.title: Tickets this journey resolves
items: Ways in and picking: keyboard-and-screen-reader-07, page-context-11, page-context-10, keyboard-and-screen-reader-06, page-context-08
Drawing: page-context-02, page-context-10, page-context-04, page-context-08
Rows, the #n flag and Undo: page-context-01, page-context-07, page-context-04, journey-agent-fix-04
Tab share and crop: page-context-09
Sent record and payload: page-context-07, page-context-02
Reload: journey-agent-fix-04 with its duplicate page-context-05
Related, not covered: page-context-03 (toolbar-shell, whose dock takes pointer input only where it draws); page-context-06 (component-source, which resolves each row's source file on React 19)

cards.title: Backend work
items: The chat draft record: /__devhost__/chat/draft (GET, PUT, DELETE) keeps a conversation's unsent images and page context per stack, page origin and conversation, never a screenshot, capped at 8 MiB, read under the Host rule, removed on an acknowledged send or a stopped stack; agent-chat builds the route (CC-19)

[discuss]: send gains pageContext beside its mode; the server renders it as a labelled 'Page context' section, counts it against 8 MiB and journals a page-context record frame (CC-40; the reference's author adds the field, with agent-chat)
The document injection names the page's service, and the chat target reports the page's checkout label (SEL-3, SEL-4)

cards.title: Contract changes
items: CC-19: selections and drawings survive a reload while their element is on the page; the draft route and its Host rule
CC-29: Escape does nothing else; Alt pressed in a shortcut or to type does not start selection; keyboard picking and two-click drawing; Undo or Mod+Z reverses the last change
CC-31: Stop Turn, or Alt+Ctrl+., stops the agent's turn, never Escape
CC-40: the record frame of kind page-context, replayed in snapshot
CC-1: docked chat and its tools paint below an open toolbar panel and never cover the notice stack

[discuss]: guides/annotations.md's numbers, payload, the tools' place and how each way into Select Elements ends; the annotations setting's description; computedStyles kept for plugins; none has a CC-n yet
